Using shell=True with an f-string command can mis‑handle paths containing spaces or special characters; prefer passing a list argument to subprocess.run to avoid quoting issues.

Assumes order.coupon is always present; if coupon is None this will raise an AttributeError. Consider handling missing coupon before accessing .percent.
